name: lvl03Enabled
meaning: 1 when LVL03WITHBOX or LVL03WITHOUTBOX is nonzero; enables the LVL03BOX cinematic trigger

name: lvl03BoxDelivered
meaning: set by msg 0x1B (sent by Mailbox_Deliver 0x4d379e); picks the WITHBOX cinematic and is cleared when used

name: lvl03CineWithBox
meaning: PROPERTY_ROCK_LVL03WITHBOX: cinematic id passed to Cine_Start (Lvl-03: 1)

name: lvl03CineWithoutBox
meaning: PROPERTY_ROCK_LVL03WITHOUTBOX: cinematic id (Lvl-03: 4)

name: lvl03Box
meaning: Scn_GetPropBox(LVL03BOX); XZ trigger that starts the Lvl-03 cinematic in states 2/3

name: lvl03CameraBox
meaning: Scn_GetPropBox(LVL03IDCAMERABOX); in state 7 the cinematic camera is released once the Wolf leaves it

name: pusher
meaning: sender of the last msg 0xA; exempt from wall-crush in Rock_Move; cleared on settle/seesaw/Reset

name: fallTime
meaning: ticks of free fall (g_dt); gravity speed = clamp(fallTime*4000>>12,200,3000); reset on floor contact; >0x800 at landing plays sfx 0x44

name: rollMatrix
meaning: rolling orientation (Matrix_RollByDisplacement), passed to Instance_DrawRigid instead of rot

name: collBox
meaning: model box 0, or box 1 when box 0 lacks flag 4 and there are >1 boxes; used for pushes, dome ground query, shadow radius

name: launch
meaning: copy of the msg 0xC launch record; t at +0xbc, camera +0xc0, obj +0xc4, camParam +0xc8, flags +0xcc

name: camShot
meaning: skippable camera shot started at launch (CamShot_Update every frame)

name: smashTime
meaning: g_gameTime when a Train smashed the rock; state 6 lasts 0x5000 ticks

name: debrisRecord
meaning: synthetic record from Scn_BuildRecordFromExport(0xDE WAR_IDO_AROCHE03)

name: debrisBody
meaning: embedded ScnBody (ctor stores ScnObject then ScnBody vtable at +0xfc); inst +0x100, pos +0x108, anim +0x13c; plays anim 3 when smashed. Typed as bytes because ScnBody.csv currently carries ScnMobile rows (0x6b, 0x78) that would make it overlap +0x160

name: pushBoxes
meaning: zone list {boxes, count}: Scn_FindIdList(ALLOWPUSHBOXES): a pushed position must overlap one of these boxes | count (+4): count for pushBoxes (0 = unrestricted)

name: stateTime
meaning: g_gameTime at the last Rock_SetState

name: homePos
meaning: position after Init (ground-snapped unless FALLSATINIT); target of Rock_ReturnHome

name: launchStartPos
meaning: pos at msg 0xC; msg 0xB snaps back to it when |x|,|z| are within 50 of it (compared by absolute value) and then zeroes it

name: seesawRestPos
meaning: scratch copy of pos taken by msg 0xB for the snap-back test

name: settleMs
meaning: ms countdown (g_dtMs, only while no movable-object contact) before a landed rock goes back to state 0; set to 2000 by many paths

name: rollSound
meaning: channel handle of the rolling loop sfx 0x106

name: pushHeading
meaning: 12-bit atan2 heading of the last push; state 3 rolls this way at 200 u/s

name: state
meaning: RockState

name: rockFlags
meaning: RockFlags
